title: Independently recount the ordinary-work bills for the role-457 edit in #7633
body:
## Result

The ordinary-work bill in #7633 reconciles to **791,355,340** for the #7631 source word and **791,537,376** for the role-457 candidate. Both use Rohan Arun’s 17-call signed caller. The candidate has **208,462,624** ordinary units of headroom.

Per call the scalar tariff rises by 7,708, one fewer MOVE saves 1,000, and one additional private lifetime costs 4,000. The complete difference is `17 × (7,708 − 1,000 + 4,000) = 182,036`. The checker matches every numerical line of the paired record and the candidate’s complete ordinary block in the application. [Cost table, derivation and source pins](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b83902aa1c16ade21415b0df58778cd606afe09e/research/pr7633-ordinary-recount/README.md)

The native conversions have their own witness. Exact integer replay of 6,660,506 source and 6,669,042 candidate scalar products gives the same least common denominator, `1125 × 2^25`. The two native SCALEs cost 104 units together for each public field. The separate signed-caller scale is 675. A fresh run of #7113’s grid program reproduced its entire caller receipt.

If all other terms are fixed, the candidate’s ordinary bill is `777,597,376 + 3,485u` at integer price `u` per lifetime per call. The largest price satisfying the billion-unit inequality for both words is 63,817. The submitted common-U contract still requires 4,000 and its full physical, scalar and precision obligations.

## Task and overlap

This takes the ordinary-accounting follow-up left in fluorine’s [#7638](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7638) at `2b80e27d55366a7ddb01f0921aa2a6f54a44927c`. Its paid/target and moment recount is complementary. The audited #7633 head is `8b885be4a553dea375303808fdfff52ed0d71019`. The source word is also the exact #7631 candidate blob at `2f1cc8c0f8c281afd2f99aeeeae6153e269f4721`. The caller is pinned to #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. [Review request](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19678892) · [Investigation claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19692060)

The revision-8 `supplier-boundary-audit` card is refined to this single bill. Canonical main was `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` at start and at submission refresh. The final reference search covered 945 open PR bodies. The handoff hub, signed-caller thread, active Discussions and related PRs were checked separately.

## Reproduction and limits

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr7633-ordinary-recount
```

- The registered replay passed on Windows 11 / CPython 3.12.0 in 12.6 seconds. It passed again from a clean checkout of the published branch. The committed-byte and source-history preflight covered all 13 package files and both declared ancestor commits.
- A Git-free committed export included all seven live inputs. Ubuntu 24.04 (WSL2), CPython 3.12.3, reproduced every output field in 4.3 seconds with `-I -B -O -W error`.
- Dividing the candidate grid by three fails before cancellation at zero-based event 1,036 and input 451. Reversing a signed query changes the expected route price by 96,000. A compensating error that preserves the grand total fails line-item comparison.

The result is finite ordinary accounting under the stated tariffs. An implementation of the shared private reset/return service, rounded physical behavior and the inherited theorem assumptions remain open. This PR is confined to one research directory.

Clear1nsight supplied #7631 and #7633, DreamingOfClouds the role-457 mechanism, Rohan Arun the signed caller, and fluorine the explicit recount request. The package retains the predecessor notice and credits the shared-native, helper and caller lineage. Mihir Srivastava prepared this recount with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Hosted CI

The [hosted plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44192773987/job/134426224277) failed in `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`. The shared CI guide still names #6030, while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The hosted replay job skipped. [#7276](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7276) tracks that navigation repair. The clean-checkout registered replay and the independent Git-free Linux run above both used the published head `b83902aa1c16ade21415b0df58778cd606afe09e`.
